pages.text: NASA's Gateways to Blue Skies (GBS) Competition | USAGov Skip to main content NASA's Gateways to Blue Skies (GBS) Competition Submit ideas to improve the reliability and efficiency of NASA's infrastructure. NASA's 2027 GBS Competition asks teams of two to six (2-6) college students to conceptualize innovative airborne platforms for inspecting land-based infrastructure. The goal is to implement the solution by 2035 to improve safety, reliability, efficiency, and cost. Based on reviews of proposals and 2-minute video submissions, up to 8 finalist teams will be selected to receive $9,000 and advance to Phase 2. In the second phase, the finalists will present at a forum in May 2027. Eligible winners will receive NASA internships. pages.text: NASA's Human Lander Challenge (HuLC) | USAGov Skip to main content NASA's Human Lander Challenge (HuLC) Develop a system to enable communications for lunar landers NASA's Human Lander Challenge (HuLC) invites collegiate teams to develop innovative systems-level solutions to understand, establish, and optimize lunar communications systems. The systems will be for landers and surface level operations and will be implemented in 3 to 5 years. Each team will submit a proposal and a two minute video.
